newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen mixed to slightly up at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen mixed to slightly up at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open slightly higher on Friday, but trading is likely to be quiet ahead of a meeting of key Federal Reserve policymakers next week, analysts said.

After a volatile week caused partly by portfolio adjustments and bond market jitters, shares may calm down as the quarter closes and investors wait to see if the Federal Open Market Committee raises rates at its July 2 session.
"I expect the stock market will take a breather today," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average, which gyrated most of the week, closed down 35.73 points at 7,654.25 on Thursday.
This morning, the Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was unchanged at 894.25.
The Federal Reserve is not expected to raise interest rates when it meets, but stocks are likely to settle into a "wait and see" pattern, watching bonds, analysts said.
